about: Step 2's plain-wall area in view A (sheet RA-A version 4, the Lead's rule of 19 November): the patch of the back wall that step 2 repaints as plain steel wall, so that no locker door, seam or handle runs into the food capsule. Two parts: the locker bank with the panels beside and below it, to the cabinet's left; and a small patch just above the cabinet's top, so that the papers' clip, behind the cabinet, is covered with 15 px to spare. Drawn as it is, not grown: step 2's mask is the furniture's outlines grown 6 px and this area. Fitted to RA-A-1 (featuresA.json). Picture pixels; the pixels whose centres lie inside a polygon.
name: plain wall
